The Milky Way appears to be slightly tilted, giving a dramatic perspective. The sky is filled with countless stars, creating a sense of vastness and infinity. The colors in the image are predominantly shades of green and white, which might be due to the lighting conditions or the use of a specific filter during the photograph.
